summary: vite-plugin-image-analysis injects hidden PII exfiltration script into built sites
details: The package advertises itself as an image-analysis / telemetry Vite plugin but contains no image-analysis code. Its transformIndexHtml hook prepends an inline script into every page of the built site. At runtime that injected script reads visitor identity fields from sessionStorage ('user' / 'user-store' -> account/username, phone, realName), hooks sessionStorage.setItem to wait for login, and transmits the collected identifiers via navigator.sendBeacon, fetch, and Image beacon fallbacks. The destination URL is not stored as a plain string: the caller-supplied `dsn` option is padded, base64-decoded (atob), then XOR'd with 42 to reconstruct the real endpoint, and the outbound query string is XOR'd with 42 and base64-encoded before transmission. The result is that any developer adding this Vite plugin to their build causes their production site to silently harvest end-user PII to an author-controlled endpoint whose address is concealed from casual inspection of the shipped bundle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
